text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ——Our encounter was nothing short of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by thunderous applause blessing our new beginning, you scouted me with burning passion, in a display that left everyone envious...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: You wrapped my shattered heart in gentle warmth, and upon that very heart, a vow was forged. ——A vow to grasp the title of strongest, together with you!
choice_data_list: …Uh, that's not how I remember it.
…Uh, that's not how I remember it.

text_block_list.text: And that was the tale of how I became Lois and Loyce's trainer. It all began with a URA-sponsored event——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone here for the "First-Time Twinkle Race Fun!" event, right this way, please!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Welcome! Please feel free to take any open seat. We're here to show you just how wonderful racing can be!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Phew... That should be all the attendees. What a wonderful full house today! Keeping an eye on every single table might be a challenge, though——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best out there, Trainer <username>!
choice_data_list: Wait, how do you know my name…?
Wait, how do you know my name…?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hm? How did I know? Why, you're listed in the staff directory, of course. Fufu. Memorizing the faces and names of every trainer at the academy is basic courtesy!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's head around the tables! Time to show our lovely guests how thrilling horse racing truly is ♪

text_block_list.name: Event Guest A
text_block_list.text: ...There are so many active Umamusume. Are the girls in this pamphlet racers too?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes! They're the center of attention in the racing world! The prestigious Mejiro family—a lineage famous for its refined grace. But each one has an incredibly unique charm!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen-san won last year's Kikka Sho. She is the very epitome of family pride—an elegant ojou-sama to the core.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ——Yet she has an adorable side too. Whenever she indulges in her beloved sweets, her face melts into sheer bliss!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And this is Mejiro Ryan. As you can see, she's a powerhouse athlete! She can hear the voice of her muscles, and her catchphrase is "Let's Muscle!"

text_block_list.name: Event Guest A
text_block_list.text: ...The voice of... her muscles...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, you heard right. She literally communes with her muscles! She excels in all sports, especially baseball—her relief pitching the other day was a complete shutout!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer-san is a gyaru. Yes, a gyaru AND a high-class lady! She's often seen hanging out with her fellow party buddy, Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: During a phase of soul-searching, she actually plunged into unsanctioned underground races, and she still drops by from time to time!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I highly recommend watching a recording of last year's Kikka Sho. You'll get to see both McQueen-san and Ryan-san in action!

text_block_list.name: Event Guest A
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! Thanks to your breakdown, they don't feel distant at all anymore. I'm definitely going to watch that race!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Next up is the hands-on Winning Concert workshop! I'll guide you through the basic chants, so just follow along with me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: HAI! HAI! HAI! HAI! Now you try!

text_block_list.name: Event Guests
text_block_list.text: Hai, hai, hai, hai...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it's totally natural! Anyone feels a little shy doing it for the first time. Hmm... How about a quick call-and-response drill?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'll give a quick shout to fire you up, and all you have to do is call my name!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: By the way, my name is Lois and Loyce. You can chant "Loyce!" or "Loyce-chan!" Let's hear some real passion, okay?
Lois and Loyce shot a quick glance in my direction. She was subtly signaling me to help lead the audience with the call.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The concert you've all been waiting for starts now! Let's get hype! Without further ado... show me your energy! Three, two, one...!

text_block_list.name: Event Guests
text_block_list.text: L... Loyce-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaa ♡ That was wonderful! Loyce is so happy ♪ One more time! Give me one more big cheer, pretty please? Three, two, one!

text_block_list.name: Event Guests
text_block_list.text: LOYCE-CHAAAAAAAAN!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yeeees! And now, a little fan service from your darling Loyce to show my thanks! Mwah ♡

text_block_list.name: Event Guest B
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Is this what they call fan service?! I get it now... you can really feel how much she appreciates the support...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Now let's try it along with the music!
In no time at all, Lois and Loyce had the whole audience completely engaged, teaching them the thrill of concert call-and-response. Then, as the mini-live ended——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Wanna tell you! Wanna show you! Gimme! Thanks for all・your・love!

text_block_list.name: Event Guests
text_block_list.text: *Thump!*
choice_data_list: (Whoa, it's just like the real thing!)
(Whoa, it's just like the real thing!)

text_block_list.name: Event Guest B
text_block_list.text: That was incredible! Man... that Loyce-chan is something else! Her stage energy and fan service are top tier! She was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Event Guest A
text_block_list.text: Right? Even though it was just an introductory demo, she gave it 120%. And the way she introduced the other runners was so heartfelt... She's such a sweet girl!
The attendees left with beaming smiles. I had no doubt that before long, every single one of them would be visiting a real racecourse.
One afternoon, curious to see the impact of our promotional efforts firsthand, I headed over to Nakayama Racecourse. Being a graded race day, the venue was packed to the brim. And then——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: *Pant... pant... pant...*
I spotted Lois and Loyce lightly jogging along the dedicated Umamusume pathway. She came to a stop near the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Event Guest C
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Hey, aren't you Loyce-chan?! Remember me from that beginner's event—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: W-Wooooow! Of course I remember you! You actually came all the way out to the racecourse! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Event Guest C
text_block_list.text: Yep! Wanted to check out that Winning Concert for real. What about you? Out here on a training run?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes! I originally just came to watch the races, but... watching them run made me realize just how much I'm still lacking.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I couldn't just sit still, so I started running laps... If I want to stand on that stage with them, I need to train twice as hard, after all...

text_block_list.name: Event Guest C
text_block_list.text: Whoa... You really work hard, don't you?! When you make your debut, I'm definitely cheering for you in the stands!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You will? Oh… I'm so overjoyed, I don't know what to say…!
Heehee! Royce's gonna do her besty!
Not unusual to train during race intermissions. But one thing bothered me…
Claimed she only came to spectate, yet brought running shoes and sports drink. Prepared, sure, but a little too prepared.
